messages:
anna_support: Hey team, Acme reported a 12k token delta between their Redwood dashboard usage and the invoice for the last 24h. They’re on our Private VPC agent (v1.13.2). They say agent was offline briefly overnight and then came back. Can we triage?

jay_infra: pinging infra. any quick checks we can run on the agent machine?

anna_support: I pulled the agent logs and the agent health output. Posting snippets below. Looks like there are sequence_id gaps and some ACKs not matching persisted events.

anna_support: ```
$ curl http://10.3.2.14:9090/agent/status
{"version":"1.13.2","uptime":"18h","queue_len":0,"last_ack_seq": 482173, "last_persisted_seq": 482186}

/var/log/redwood-meter.log:
[2026-02-12T03:14:22Z] INFO persisted seq 482170
[2026-02-12T03:14:22Z] INFO persisted seq 482171
[2026-02-12T03:14:23Z] INFO acked seq 482170
[2026-02-12T03:14:23Z] INFO acked seq 482172
[2026-02-12T03:14:25Z] WARN failed resend for seq 482174: connection reset
[2026-02-12T03:15:01Z] INFO persisted seq 482185
[2026-02-12T03:15:02Z] INFO acked seq 482185
```

anna_support: see how ack jumps from 482170 to 482172 (482171 ack missing) and persisted goes ahead to 482186 while last_ack_seq is 482173 in status. customer audit logs show tokens for seqs up to 482186, but our billing engine only counted up to 482173.

mike: (not in thread) looks like intermittent network outage + agent retry bug could cause duplicate persists but dropped ack updates.

jay_infra: Can you confirm agent restart window? Is there any time where the agent was force-killed? Also which tier of connectivity — NAT gateway or direct peering?

anna_support: Customer says they saw an autoscaling event on their infra between 03:13-03:16 UTC. They think the host was rebooted by their infra team. I requested their host boot logs.

miguel_sre: fwiw we shipped a change in 1.13.x that re-ordered ACK flush to disk; if the process is killed during ack flush we can persist the event but not the ack pointer. That would show up as persisted_seq > last_ack_seq. If that’s the case, our downstream billing ingest will de-dupe by ack pointer and miss those into the invoice.

sarah_billing: That matches the delta size: ~12k tokens across ~13 seqs that are persisted but not acked. If confirmed, we should reconcile by replaying those seqs into the billing pipeline so invoice + dashboard match. Customer is asking for quick remediation.

jay_infra: Steps to triage I recommend: 1) capture agent status and log tail (already posted) 2) pull agent persisted queue file: /var/lib/redwood-meter/queue.db 3) run seq-checker tool to compute gaps: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/seq-checker --path /var/lib/redwood-meter/queue.db --report` 4) tell customer to hold on invoice adjustments until we confirm root cause.

anna_support: Ran seq-checker and attached summary: `missing_seqs: [482171,482174] duplicate_persist: [482172] replayable_count: 2`

anna_support: Also saw this in agent journal around the reboot: `systemd: Stopping redwood-meter.service` then `kernel: OOM killer invoked` — so a force kill during ack flush seems likely.

metering-bot: agent-heartbeat 10.3.2.14 last_seen=1765123100 ack_seq=482173 persisted_seq=482186 status=degraded

miguel_sre: Next actions — if we can safely replay the two missing seqs (482171, 482174) into our billing pipeline, that should fix the invoice delta. I'll prepare a replay job that marks events as reconciled. Need a go-ahead from billing and customer consent. Also we should patch agent to 1.14.0 where ack flush is atomic.

sarah_billing: Please do not run a replay without logging an official reconciliation request and getting customer signoff. I'll open a billing ticket and ping legal for audit trail. Meanwhile we can generate a provisional credit if customer demands fast fix.

anna_support: I'll coordinate with Acme and ask for permission to replay; requesting their host boot log and a signed reconciliation approval. Also asked their infra to confirm whether they killed process or if OOM happened.

jay_infra: After replay, we should also run an integrity check: compare audit-log token totals vs invoice after replay. If we see any more gaps, escalate to SRE for deeper analysis.

anna_support: ack. I'll update here once I have customer consent. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sarah_billing: Sending billing ticket now — TKT-45892. tagging for follow-up and credit guidance. :white_check_mark:

miguel_sre: One more mitigation: add a small on-exit ack flush and fsync guard in agent to reduce window where ack can be lost. Adding to 1.13.3 patch.
